text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm visiting the cafeteria for lunch<n>when I find
Shinko Windy there<n>sneaking glances at Biwa
Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, she's back! And she<n>doesn't suspect a
thing!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is my cup in a slightly different<n>position? No, it
must just be my<n>imagination.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Gack! What is this?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyahaha! You really drank it! I bet it<n>was super
gross!
choice_data_list: What have you pulled now, Windy?!
What have you pulled now, Windy?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I swapped out her drink with my own
specially-made vile brew! How d'ya<n>like that,
Hayahide?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...So this was your doing, Windy. I<n>was surprised to
taste something<n>other than my usual coffee.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Was it so disgusting that ya<n>feel like
crying now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The contents seem to be a<n>blend of coffee
mixed with a variety<n>of vegetables. It definitely
wasn't a<n>pleasant taste, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Considering the vitamins, minerals,<n>and amino acids
it contains, along<n>with alpha-lipoic acids...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can say it's actually quite a fine<n>beverage packed
full of nutrients!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat? The heck are you talking<n>about?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Improve the flavor and I'm sure<n>everyone would
enjoy it. I could<n>share some reference data on
drink<n>compounds if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: N-n-no way! I don't want everyone to<n>enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Graaagh! Now I'm pissed! I'll get you<n>next time,
Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That'll do it! The hole is perfectly<n>hidden! ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, a pitfall this time, is it?<n>However, you should
make sure the<n>color of the grass you put on top
matches. It's pretty easy to spot the<n>difference.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a toy snake. It looks quite realistic<n>from a
distance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Though I'd say your chances of<n>frightening
someone would be<n>improved if you were to partially
conceal it in a patch of grass. What do<n>you think?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Arghhh! I never asked for any of your<n>advice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy continues her efforts to<n>prank Biwa
Hayahide. However, each<n>attempt ends in complete
failure.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I simply wanted to help you<n>finally pull one off
on me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think considering my<n>honest feedback
would improve your<n>ability to plan?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I don't want yer help! I wanna scare<n>the pants off
ya by myself!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's so funny?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, forgive me. This exchange just<n>now reminded
me of my childhood.<n>Although my sister was never
quite<n>as mischievous as you are.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grawr! Don't compare me to your<n>little sister!
Windy is Windy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Growing more irritated by the second,<n>Shinko Windy
seems to be on the<n>verge of launching herself at
Biwa<n>Hayahide. I should say something to<n>calm the
situation.
choice_data_list: Let's try following Biwa Hayahide's advice.
Stick to your guns and scare her your way!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr! Do you really think it'll work if I<n>do?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hrnngh, I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm? There's something in those<n>shrubs... Is this a
toy snake?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, she appears to have listened to<n>my advice.
Although, now I feel bad<n>that I've ruined the
surprise—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: BOO!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! You let your guard down!<n>As if I'd ever
follow your stupid<n>advice!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-I see... The toy was merely a<n>decoy...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you got me, Windy. That was a<n>splendid
prank.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mwahahaha! Of course it was! You<n>never had a
chance, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy takes the advice given<n>to her, but
also goes one step further<n>and successfully scares
Biwa<n>Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm gonna start thinking up<n>tons more
pranks to try out!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Is that so? It appears my<n>advice has fallen
on deaf ears, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to seeing what kind of<n>prank you
have in store for me next,<n>Windy.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grawr! You're not supposed to<n>enjoy this! This is
all a waste of time<n>if you're not terrified!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my apologies. Then I will cower in<n>fear while I
await your next prank.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! Damn you, Hayahide! I'm<n>definitely gonna
shock you<n>senseless!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait! I'm gonna think up an<n>amazing
prank that'll make you<n>shriek in terror!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy immediately sets about<n>devising a
new prank. I get the sense<n>that she's actually
enjoying the<n>challenge.
